summary: Candidate e32bd205e2a9ec107903f9b03da56802e4868200 is a verified partial observability improvement, not the requested full-lifecycle framework. It exports UnifiedRadixCache L3 query hit/partial-hit/miss and existing prefetch scheduling outcomes, and adds request-correlated L3 query and terminal prefetch logs. The base failure reproduces and the candidate CPU and real-GPU regressions pass, but L1/L2 transfer success/failure metrics, end-to-end request tracing across all tiers, and equivalent coverage for legacy HiRadixCache are not implemented.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression at the exact recorded base: TypeError because StorageMetrics did not accept prefetch_stats. Raw log: /job/review-evidence-j-809204b0a14a/base/original-regression.log

Candidate's focused observability suite: 16 passed, covering collector deltas, reset epochs, bounded labels, and existing storage failure-token counters. Raw log and JUnit are preserved under /job/review-evidence-j-809204b0a14a/candidate/.

On one AMD Instinct MI350X, 13 passed and 6 repository-gated cases skipped. This exercised actual file-backed L3 query, host staging, GPU load-back, K/V equality checks, and delivery of the new L3 hit snapshot. It does not exercise other backends, legacy HiRadixCache, or complete cross-tier failure tracing.

tests.command: independent source-path and contract inspection at candidate e32bd205e2a9ec107903f9b03da56802e4868200
tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed imports resolve to /job/repo/python/sglang, no native files changed, new lifecycle snapshots originate only in UnifiedRadixCache, and structured rid logs cover storage_query and terminal storage_prefetch rather than the full L1/L2/L3 lifecycle. Evidence: /job/review-evidence-j-809204b0a14a/candidate/import-paths.log and full.diff.

gpu_evidence: Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015, one AMD Instinct MI350X; candidate GPU round-trip completed 13 passed, 6 skipped.
remaining_counterexamples: An L1-to-L2 transfer failure has no new candidate metric or unified rid event; the patch's new request/token result metrics describe L3 queries only.

A request cannot be followed through a unified sequence of L1, L2, and L3 lifecycle events: only UnifiedRadixCache storage_query and terminal storage_prefetch receive the proposed [HICACHE] rid format.
Legacy HiRadixCache does not produce the new prefetch_stats snapshot, so deployments using that implementation do not receive the new L3 request classification.
Mooncake, HF3FS, NIXL, UMBP, multi-node, TP/PP distributed, and model-specific storage paths remain unverified on this node.
remaining_limitations: No C++/FlyDSL/native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable; Python imports were confirmed from the candidate checkout rather than an installed stale copy.
The available architecture was one AMD Instinct MI350X. No NVIDIA/CUDA or multi-GPU architecture was available.
The direct GPU cache round-trip qualifies the modified file-storage path, not semantic model accuracy, HTTP serving, distributed execution, or unavailable storage backends.

Existing storage_prefetch_unfulfilled_tokens_total offers token-level failure reasons, but the candidate does not implement the original proposal's complete cross-layer transfer success/failure and request-trace contract.
